patches_added.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_added.description: Makes the number of icons on the toolbar above the keyboard adjustable, from Gboard's own settings. Anything past the limit stays in the overflow menu.

patches_removed.name: Android Auto
patches_removed.description: Injects full Android Auto support into Petal Maps, including CarAppService, manifest declarations, and required resources. Also apply 'Anti-Repack Bypass' and 'Manufacturer Check Bypass' for full functionality on non-Huawei devices.

patches_removed.name: Android Auto API Level File
patches_removed.description: Adds car-app-api.level to the APK root for androidx.car.app compatibility.

patches_removed.name: Android Auto Manifest
patches_removed.description: Adds the Android Auto CarAppService declaration, meta-data, and permissions to AndroidManifest.xml.

patches_removed.name: Android Auto Resources
patches_removed.description: Adds the automotive_app_desc.xml resource required by Android Auto.

patches_removed.name: Android Auto allowlist (root)
patches_removed.description: Registers the app in Android Auto's allowlist on startup when root is available; no-op without root.

patches_removed.name: Automotive orientation fix (main activity)
patches_removed.description: Changes PetalMapsActivity's screenOrientation from behind to sensorLandscape so it renders in landscape on the car display.
